description: S462 Q18 — an event handler inside an `if=@user` gate keeps `@user`'s narrowing: the bare `@user.name` in it compiles. RUNTIME half: the click while present renders the name; signing out (another control) removes the gated subtree and its listener synchronously, so the handler can no longer run — `#go` is gone and `@out` keeps its value. (Dispatching a click on the DETACHED `#go` — the driver's selector verbs cannot address a removed element — is asserted by compiler/tests/browser/browser-gated-handler-narrowing-s462.browser.test.js.)
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q18): an event handler on an element — or inside a subtree — gated by `if=` / `else-if=` on a presence test of a cell KEEPS that cell's narrowing inside the handler: render-gating removes the subtree and its listener synchronously on the write that ends the condition.
